import subprocess,os,itertools
# try using the actual seed corpus files as inputs
import zipfile, tempfile
zf=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/avc_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for name in zf.namelist():
    if name.endswith('/'):
        continue
    data=zf.read(name)
    p='/tmp/seed.bin'
    open(p,'wb').write(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['./mvc_dec_fuzzer',p,'-runs=1'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('crash seed',name,r.returncode,len(data))
        break
else:
    print('no crash on seeds')
